items.title: Seedance 2.5
items.description: Seedance 2.5 Image to Video generates videos from a single image URL with optional prompts, customizable duration, resolution, and output format. It supports adding an end image and generating audio to enhance the video output.

items.title: Seedance 2.5
items.description: Seedance 2.5 Reference to Video generates videos from images, videos, or audio inputs with customizable duration, resolution, aspect ratio, and output format. It supports image-to-video and video-to-video transformations, allowing creative control through prompts and audio integration.

items.title: Seedance 2.5

Generate videos from text, images, video, and audio references, with clips up to 30 seconds.
Animate images, edit or extend existing footage, and generate audio alongside your video.

items.title: Seedance 2.5
items.description: Seedance 2.5 Video Extend generates extended video content from an input video URL and text prompt, supporting up to 30 seconds duration and optional audio or image inputs. It outputs videos in 480p or 720p resolution with mp4 or mov format, allowing control over audio generation and multiple media inputs.

items.title: Kling 3.0 Pro
